### God’s Presence Is All We Need
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-15-2023.html
Passage: Exodus 33:1-3
Points:
- God promised Israel guidance and the Promised Land, but withheld His own personal presence due to their rebellion.
- Many believers settle for assurance of heaven and divine protection without experiencing God's active presence in daily life.
- Material provisions and safety do not prove spiritual health, since even unbelievers receive basic earthly blessings.
- Believers should never be content with blessings, answers to prayer, or promises apart from God Himself.

### Stiff Neck
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/stiff-neck-encouragement-cafe-march-16.html
Passage: Exodus 33:5
Points:
- God identified the Israelites as stiff-necked, confronting their stubborn, harsh, and obstinate attitudes.
- Adults often become rigid and willfully selective about what truths they choose to believe and obey.
- The tragic outcome of persistent obstinacy is the spiritual isolation of being left to oneself without God's fellowship.
- Believers must ask the Lord to soften their hard attitudes so their hearts remain moldable in His hands.
